description: Assembly orders (AOs) with components, damage, stage updates and labour tasks; bulk batches with QC results; manufacturing jobs; FG component lists; AO/batch allocations to order lines. FM bronze is authoritative for AOs and batches; gold copies are linked by code, never merged. Planned, produced, manufactured, accepted, retained and damaged quantities keep distinct roles. Formulas, BOMs and quality/eQMS records are declared not_served (Q3). Lane L5b.

link_types.name: same_record_as
link_types.description: FM batch -> the gold batch record the silver-to-gold ETL upserted it into: namebatch_c = batch_name. The ETL upserts ON CONFLICT (batch_number) with batch_number = COALESCE(namebatch_c, lotno_c, id) (etl-silver-to-gold.ts:923 @b46934a; silver.batches display_batch_number), so FM batches sharing a name collapse into one gold row (insert-time columns from the lowest FM id, status/QC from the last upsert). A gold row can therefore have several FM batches; its values are not attributable to any one of them.

link_types.name: for_order_line
link_types.description: Gold MO -> the sales order line it produces (Portal-native SO Produce lines; FM AOs use AssemblyOrderAllocation, and since Portal 57bd403 (TASK-2711, staging 38cd3f3) an FM-born AO linked to a portal order line also carries it here: linkAoToPortalLine sets salesOrderLineId on the gold MO whose mo_code is the AO's nameamo_c, for an open MAKE line of the same product and customer, because a MAKE order confirmed after 898e084 TASK-2638 has no FileMaker order_entry line to put in order_entry_item_assembly). At most one live MO per sales order line: the Portal refuses to create or tag an MO onto a line while another MO on it is neither CANCELLED nor soft-deleted (409; code SOL_ALREADY_HAS_MO on tag), and shows that one live MO on the line (liveLinkedMo, portal/src/lib/mrp/mo-so-line-link.ts@549f6f0; portal/src/lib/mrp/api-handlers/manufacturing-orders.ts@549f6f0 resolveLinkedSalesOrderLine and tagExistingSalesOrderLine). The rule is an API-handler check, not a unique index, and cancelled or soft-deleted MOs keep their line id: the raw link stays N:1, so a line can list several MOs of which at most one is live.

evidence.note: ManufacturingOrder.salesOrderLineId -> SalesOrderLine (SO Produce line -> MO); ManufacturingJob.salesOrderId -> SalesOrder.

One live MO per sales order line, read at plx-customer-portal@549f6f0 (newer than this domain's b46934a pin; pinned and drift-watched in devloop/upstream-pins.json): portal/src/lib/mrp/mo-so-line-link.ts:13-16 liveLinkedMo (the one not-CANCELLED MO on a line, TASK-2397 568f69c8); portal/src/lib/mrp/api-handlers/manufacturing-orders.ts:154-168 resolveLinkedSalesOrderLine (create: 409) and :815-834 tagExistingSalesOrderLine (tag: 409 SOL_ALREADY_HAS_MO), each while another MO on the line is not CANCELLED and deletedAt is null.
